pages.text: All three rods carry $(4)6 trillion$(0) energy each; only their temper differs:$(li)$(bold)Mixed Rod$(0): 4M/t yield, 27M heat value — balanced, ideal for stacking efficiency frames$(li)$(bold)Nether Rod$(0): 4M/t yield, 40M heat — high output and heat, bring serious cooling$(li)$(bold)End Rod$(0): 2.6M/t yield, 15M heat — mild; four of them with no cooling land right in the fusion sweet spot$(br2)How to burn them: see "$(l:akaishi:fusion)Fusion Reactor$(/l)".
Rods are made by the $(l:akaishi:plasma_filler)Plasma Filler$(/l); to burn them, follow the $(l:akaishi:fusion)Fusion Reactor$(/l) layout.
